$comment: Maps each drawn Figma component to the code. See guidelines/figma/03-agent-guide.md. Checked against the built manifest by `pnpm check-figma-map`. No file key, file address or node id belongs here.

dot.note: a dot ignores the solid or subtle choice, so it is a value of variant here

on.note: an anchored badge (the anchor prop is set) gets this 2 px surface ring; anchor, position and overlap are placement and are not modelled

deviations: dot is a value of variant in Figma, and the dot prop in code
position and overlap are layout: the badge is placed by hand and the spec frame shows the offsets
the pop animation is motion and is not drawn

coverage.exception: All seven tones and all five sizes are drawn: a badge's tone is a status, and its sm, md and lg are only 2 to 3 px apart, so xs and xl are the sizes that differ. 105 variants.

neutral.recipe: Primary: fill bg/neutral (bg/neutral-hover on hover) and label text/on-neutral. Secondary: edge border/neutral-strong, label text/secondary, hover fill bg/neutral-subtle. Tertiary: label text/secondary, hover fill bg/neutral-subtle. Ghost: fill bg/neutral-subtle (bg/neutral-subtle-hover on hover), label text/secondary. Icons use tone default, except on the primary (on-brand); the icon size follows the button size (xs and sm buttons take the xs icon, md and lg the sm icon, xl the md icon). Name the instance Button (tone=neutral).

xs.recipe: Label text style Components/Control/xs, horizontal padding space/3, vertical padding space/2 (one pixel less on a secondary, whose border takes it), gap space/2, icons at the xs icon size; name the instance Button (size=xs)

on.note: swap the nested icon in place; the tone follows the variant and tone
swap the nested icon in place; the tone follows the variant and tone

deviations: destructive ignores tone; only the brand tone is drawn, and the neutral tone is in undrawn.tone
rounded is a variant property (false, true), not a boolean, because it changes the corner radius
fullWidth is set by making the instance fill its container
xs is in the code and is not drawn: see undrawn.size

coverage.exception: Widened and narrowed: size xl is drawn (a real marketing size) and every state at every drawn size, with rounded off and on; the neutral tone and size xs are not drawn. 200 variants.

xs.recipe: Text style Components/Field/xs, horizontal padding space/2, vertical padding 7, height 30, icon size icon-size/xs; name the instance Input (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Text style Components/Field/lg, horizontal padding space/4, vertical padding 15, height 59, icon size icon-size/xl; name the instance Input (size=xl)

on.note: an icon, or text typed over it
an icon, or text typed over it
the clear button shows when there is a value and onClear is given
needs maxLength

count.derived: drawn by showCount from the value length and maxLength

deviations: filled is a variant property with no code prop of its own: it only changes the text colour (placeholder or value)
the Figma variants are 280 px wide and a fixed height per size; the code is width 100% and its height comes from the line height and padding
the clear button is drawn as its icon only: its hover fill and hit area are not drawn
disabled together with error, and hover on error or disabled, are not drawn

coverage.note: Default coverage: sizes sm, md and lg, every state at every size.

info.recipe: Edge border/info, and bg/info-subtle behind the header; name the instance Card (tone=info)

success.recipe: Edge border/success, and bg/success-subtle behind the header; name the instance Card (tone=success)

warning.recipe: Edge border/warning, and bg/warning-subtle behind the header; name the instance Card (tone=warning)

danger.recipe: Edge border/danger, and bg/danger-subtle behind the header; name the instance Card (tone=danger)

xs.recipe: Padding of the header, body and footer space/3; name the instance Card (size=xs)

sm.recipe: Padding of the header, body and footer space/4; name the instance Card (size=sm)

lg.recipe: Padding of the header, body and footer space/8; name the instance Card (size=lg)

xl.recipe: Padding of the header, body and footer space/10; name the instance Card (size=xl)

media-start.note: Card.Media at the top of a vertical card

media-end.note: Card.Media at the bottom of a vertical card

side-start.note: Card.Media beside the content, at the inline start

side-end.note: Card.Media beside the content, at the inline end

hover.note: CSS :hover; an interactive card is a link or button supplied with asChild

media.note: only in the four layouts with media

deviations: layout is one Figma property for orientation, mediaPosition and whether Card.Media is used; a card without media looks the same in both orientations
an elevated card is drawn with the light elevation styles; effect styles cannot switch with a theme, so a dark theme applies Elevation/dark/* and border/default by hand
the variants are 320 px wide (560 px beside the media) with a height that hugs the content; the code is as wide as its container
orientation can change by breakpoint in code; Figma draws each layout and the designer picks one per frame
Card.Footer's align and the other part props are layout inside the slot content, not modelled
in a side layout the footer follows the body; the code pins it to the bottom when the media is taller
states are drawn at the stacked layout only: layout does not change what a state does

coverage.exception: Narrowed: only size md and tones neutral and brand are drawn. A card's size only changes the section padding and its tone only the edge and the header tint, so each undrawn value has a one-line recipe.

xs.recipe: Text style Components/Textarea/xs, horizontal padding space/2, vertical padding space/1, icon size icon-size/xs; name the instance Textarea (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Text style Components/Textarea/lg, horizontal padding space/4, vertical padding space/3, icon size icon-size/xl; name the instance Textarea (size=xl)

on.note: the clear button shows in the top end corner when there is a value and onClear is given
needs maxLength; the box grows by the count's height

count.derived: drawn by showCount from the value length and maxLength

deviations: filled is a variant property with no code prop of its own: it only changes the text colour (placeholder or value)
the Figma variants are 280 px wide and three lines tall (rows is 3); the code is width 100% and its height comes from rows, minRows, maxRows or autoResize
the text uses the Components/Textarea styles, which have an Auto line height because a textarea falls back to the browser's normal line height, unlike Input's tight one
the clear button is drawn as its icon in a 4 px ring, with no hover fill, and the text's end padding is not reserved for it (the code reserves space-8 whenever onClear is given)
the corner drag handle that resize shows is a browser control and is not drawn
hover on error or disabled, disabled together with error, and readOnly are not drawn (no style in the CSS)

coverage.note: Default coverage: sizes sm, md and lg, every state at every size (3 x 6 x 2 = 36).

xs.recipe: Box 12 px (icon-size/xs) and check icon icon-size/xs; name the instance Checkbox (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Box 32 px (icon-size/xl) and check icon icon-size/md; name the instance Checkbox (size=xl)

true.note: checked, with the check icon; also defaultChecked true

indeterminate.note: with the minus icon; also defaultChecked indeterminate

on.note: the label beside the box; a checkbox named only by aria-label has it off

deviations: the check or minus icon is chosen by checked (an unchecked variant has no icon layer), not by a boolean, so no combination the code cannot produce is drawn
the focus ring is a layer 12 px larger than the box with a 2 px edge, drawn outside it at a 4 px gap, with its radius at radius/md (the code expands the box radius by the offset)
showLabel is off by default as children is, so the set shows the bare box; the spec frame instances turn it on
the invisible 24 px hit area the code adds around a box smaller than that is not drawn
hover on error or disabled, disabled together with error, and the hover edge colour of a checked, invalid box are not drawn

coverage.note: Default coverage: sizes sm, md and lg, every state at every size and every checked value (3 x 6 x 3 = 54); error-focus is drawn because an invalid, focused box differs from both.

xs.recipe: Circle 12 px (icon-size/xs) and dot 6 px; name the instance Radio (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Circle 32 px (icon-size/xl) and dot 16 px; name the instance Radio (size=xl)

true.note: checked, with the dot; also defaultChecked true

on.note: the label beside the circle; a radio named only by aria-label has it off

deviations: the dot is half the circle, a value the code derives with a percentage, so it is drawn at that size and unbound, and scales with the circle (SCALE constraints)
the focus ring is a fully round layer 12 px larger than the circle with a 2 px edge, drawn outside it at a 4 px gap
showLabel is off by default as children is, so the set shows the bare circle; the spec frame instances turn it on
the invisible 24 px hit area the code adds around a circle smaller than that is not drawn
hover on error or disabled, disabled together with error, and the brand-coloured hover edge of a checked, invalid circle are not drawn

coverage.note: Default coverage: sizes sm, md and lg, every state at every size and both checked values (3 x 6 x 2 = 36); error-focus is drawn because an invalid, focused circle differs from both.

default.note: a spinner with no tone takes its parent's colour in code; default is the drawn default

on-neutral.recipe: Use on-brand, which is the same colour in every theme; name the instance Spinner (tone=on-neutral)

xl.recipe: Ring 32 px (icon-size/xl); name the instance Spinner (size=xl)

deviations: a spinner with no tone inherits its parent's colour in code; the drawn default is the default tone
the ring is drawn still: the code turns it once per motion.duration.slower (four times slower with reduced motion) and Figma holds no animation here

the ring is one stroked open path (a three-quarter circle with the gap at the top) in a square frame, with its 2 px stroke bound to border-width/2; its radius is half the frame less half the stroke, a derived number
label (the status role and accessible name) has no visual and is not modelled

coverage.exception: Widened: 16 of the Icon set's 17 tones (all but on-neutral), because a spinner takes its colour from where it sits (Switch uses secondary, a filled Button on-brand) and not from a status; and size xs besides sm, md and lg, because the sm Switch nests a 12 px spinner. 16 x 4 = 64 variants, well under the budget.

xs.recipe: Track 20 x 36 px, thumb 16 px, icon icon-size/xs; name the instance Switch (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Track 40 x 72 px, thumb 36 px, icon icon-size/md; name the instance Switch (size=xl)

loading.note: also disables the switch and marks it busy; the thumb holds a Spinner

true.note: on, the thumb at the far end; also defaultChecked true

on.note: the thumb shows the unchecked icon when off and the checked icon when on; swap the nested icon in place and keep its tone
the label beside the track; a switch named only by aria-label has it off

deviations: the track and thumb sizes are results of calc() in the code (the md height is space/6 plus space/1, the width is 1.8 times the height, the thumb is the height less 4 px), so they are drawn as numbers and left unbound; only the sm and lg heights are bound (space/6 and space/8)
the thumb icons are the placeholders Icon/X (off, tone secondary) and Icon/Check (on, tone brand); the code takes any icon through checkedIcon and uncheckedIcon, and shows none by default
the error ring is a frame 2 px outside the track with a 2 px edge, the code's box-shadow; the focus ring is a frame 6 px outside it, the code's outline at a 4 px offset
the loading state is drawn as disabled (the whole switch at 40% opacity) with a Spinner in the thumb, as the code disables a loading switch; it has no thumb icon
showLabel is off by default as children is, so the set shows the bare track; the spec frame instances turn it on
the right-to-left thumb direction is not drawn: Figma has no :dir(rtl), and right-to-left is deferred
hover on error, disabled or loading, and disabled or loading together with error, are not drawn

coverage.note: Default coverage: sizes sm, md and lg, every state at every size and both checked values (3 x 7 x 2 = 42); error-focus is drawn because an invalid, focused switch differs from both, and loading because it is a state with its own look.

neutral.recipe: Same layout; primary bg/neutral with icon on-neutral (hover bg/neutral-hover), secondary edge border/neutral-strong with icon default, tertiary and ghost icon default on bg/neutral-subtle (hover bg/neutral-subtle-hover); pressed inverts as the brand does; name the instance IconButton (tone=neutral)

xs.recipe: Box 30 px (icon-button/size/xs), icon icon-size/xs, label padding space/1 both ways; name the instance IconButton (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Box 61 px (icon-button/size/xl), icon icon-size/xl, label padding space/2 and space/3 with the Components/IconButton/sm style; name the instance IconButton (size=xl)

pressed.note: the toggle is on: the icon takes the fill weight and the colours invert

loading.note: also disables the button; a Spinner takes the icon's place

on.note: the caption under the icon; the box grows to fit it

deviations: destructive ignores the tone; only the brand tone is drawn, and the neutral tone is in undrawn.tone
pressed and pressed-hover are values of state, not a property of their own; pressed together with focus, disabled or loading is not drawn
the box is a frame with a minimum width and height bound to the icon-button size variables, hugging its content, so showLabel grows it under the icon as the code does
the icon is the placeholder Icon/Plus in the variant's icon tone, swapped in place for the code's required icon prop; it is the fill weight when pressed
loading draws the Spinner set (size sm, 80% opacity) where the code draws its own ring, the same shape and size
the focus variants drop the box's corner radius to sm (full when rounded) and draw the ring 6 px outside at radius lg, as the code does
hideLabelBelow is not modelled: showLabel stands for the label shown at a wide enough viewport
hover on disabled or loading, and a labelled pressed destructive toggle under the pointer, are not drawn

coverage.exception: Narrowed: only the brand tone and sizes sm, md and lg are drawn (the neutral tone and xs and xl are undrawn, each with a recipe), as Button's tone is, so that every state is drawn at every size with rounded off and on: 5 variants x 3 sizes x 7 states x 2 = 210 variants, under the budget.

brand.recipe: Same layout; the icon in tone brand (icon/brand) and the hover fill bg/brand-subtle-hover; name the instance CloseButton (tone=brand)

white.recipe: Same layout on a dark surface; the icon in tone white (icon/white), the hover fill icon/white at 20% opacity, the focus ring border/white, and with hasBackground the Scrim filled bg/overlay; name the instance CloseButton (tone=white)

xs.recipe: Box 30 px (icon-button/size/xs), icon icon-size/xs; name the instance CloseButton (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Box 61 px (icon-button/size/xl), icon icon-size/xl; name the instance CloseButton (size=xl)

on.note: a translucent bg/scrim layer at 40% opacity behind the icon, for use over images

deviations: only the neutral tone, the code's default, is drawn; the brand and white tones are in undrawn.tone
the box is a fixed square bound to the icon-button size variables, the same as IconButton's at each size
hasBackground is a boolean that shows a Scrim layer above the hover fill and below the icon, as the code's ::before is painted; the scrim takes the box's own radius
the focus variants drop the box's corner radius to sm (full when rounded) and draw the ring 6 px outside at radius lg, as the code does
aria-label defaults to Close in the code and is not modelled
hover on disabled is not drawn: the code excludes it

coverage.note: Narrowed to the neutral tone, the code's default: sizes sm, md and lg, every state at every size with rounded off and on (3 x 4 x 2 = 24); the brand and white tones are undrawn, with a recipe.

xs.recipe: Apply the Components/FieldLabel/xs text style (font-size/xs) to the label and the marker of an sm instance; name the instance FieldLabel (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Apply the Components/FieldLabel/lg text style (font-size/lg) to the label and the marker of an lg instance; name the instance FieldLabel (size=xl)

on.note: a space and an asterisk in text/danger after the label; decorative and hidden from assistive technology in the code

deviations: the asterisk keeps text/danger when the label is disabled, as the code does, because its own colour rule overrides the inherited one
the marker is a second text layer holding a space and an asterisk, so it takes the same style and no unbound gap is needed
the label hugs its text, as the inline-block does; an instance is not fixed to a width
the code has no hover, focus or pressed style, so none is drawn

coverage.note: Default coverage: sizes sm, md and lg, both states at every size (3 x 2 = 6); required is a boolean, not multiplied. xs and xl are undrawn, with a recipe.

deviations: the set hugs its text, while the code is a block that fills its parent; an instance set to fill, with the text set to wrap, matches it
the code has no hover, focus or error style, so none is drawn

coverage.note: The code has no size or tone prop, so the one axis is state, default and disabled (2); nothing is undrawn.

on.note: the nested warning icon, bold, 12 px, tone danger (disabled when disabled); a custom glyph is swapped in place on the nested instance

deviations: the set hugs its content, as the inline-flex does; an instance set to fill, with the text set to wrap, matches a message that wraps
the icon takes its colour from its tone variant (danger, or disabled when disabled), where the code gives it the text colour through currentColor
a custom icon glyph is swapped in place on the nested icon, not drawn as a variant
the one-shot fade and slide on mount is not drawn, and the code has no hover, focus or pressed style

coverage.note: The code has no size or tone prop, so the one axis is state, default and disabled (2); the icon is a boolean, not multiplied. Nothing is undrawn.

xs.recipe: Font size xs (Components/Tag/xs), padding space/1 by space/2, icons icon-size/xs; name the instance Tag (size=xs)

xl.recipe: Font size base (Components/Tag/base), padding space/2 by space/3, icons icon-size/md; name the instance Tag (size=xl)

hover.note: CSS :hover on an interactive tag, no prop

focus.note: CSS :focus-visible on an interactive tag, no prop

selected.note: also defaultSelected; the tag is then interactive

disabled.note: only meaningful on an interactive tag

on.note: an icon swapped in place on the nested instance
an icon swapped in place on the nested instance
the remove glyph, a nested Icon/X

deviations: hover and focus are states with no prop of their own: they are CSS on a tag that is interactive through onClick, selected, defaultSelected or onSelectedChange
the remove glyph's frame is 4 px narrower than its icon, which stands for the code's negative end margin that pulls the glyph in
the highlight tone's icon uses the highlight tone, where the code leaves it to inherit text/highlight, which is darker in the light themes
a subtle or outlined tag has a 1 px edge that counts in its size and a solid tag has none, so a solid tag is 2 px shorter, as in the code
a selected solid tag's halo is two ring layers drawn outside the tag, standing for the code's two box-shadow layers
hover on a selected tag, a disabled selected tag, the remove glyph's own hover and focus, and the mount and press motion are not drawn

a label longer than the room the tag is in is shortened with an ellipsis in code (the tag has a maximum width of its container); the set hugs its text and has no maximum width, so no shortening is drawn

coverage.exception: All three looks, all seven tones, sizes sm, md and lg and all five states are drawn: a tag's tone is a feedback colour, as a badge's is, and every state is drawn at every size and tone, so the set is not sparse (3 x 7 x 3 x 5 = 315). The icon and remove booleans and the label are not multiplied. xs and xl are undrawn, with a recipe.
